'''Tor Haido''' was a resident of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Tor Haido assisted the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in its occupation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] by acting as a spy. Through this work, he came to know the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Suljo Warde]] well. After public opinion turned against Warde, Haido attempted to distance himself from the Jedi.<ref name="CotG" />
